hints.title: Boundary Extreme Principle
hints.text: The pair of houses with maximal separation must include either the first house or the last house.

hints.title: Scan from Ends
hints.text: Compare the color of the first house with houses from right to left, and vice versa for the last house.

hints.title: Maximal Distance Selection
hints.text: The result is the maximum of the two distances found from the respective boundaries.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: The optimal pair must involve either the very first house or the very last house.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: All-pairs comparison takes O(N^2) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Checking against endpoints isolates the maximal distance in two linear scans.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that maximum span always touches an extreme boundary.
